subject: [PATCH v1 1/3] virtio_fs: zero the correct range on a short read reply

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch fixes a bug in the virtio_fs module where it incorrectly zeroed the unfilled tail of a short read reply when the read started at an offset within a folio. The fix is to calculate the correct range to be zeroed based on the descriptor's offset and length, rather than relying on an assumption that only holds for small folios. This patch also removes a WARN_ON statement that was added as a diagnostic aid but is no longer needed. The change is necessary to enable support for large folios in virtio-fs.
